_comment: Shared cases for the SPIRE CLI source (SpireWorkloadApiSvidSource; Go SpireWorkloadAPISvidSource, Java SvidSource.SpireWorkloadApi) when spire-agent starts a background helper that inherits its stdout. Each port's tests write `#!/bin/sh` + `script` to an executable file, use it as the spire-agent binary, call fetch once, and check that within `max_ms` it returns `token`, fails with exactly the message `error`, or fails with EvidenceNotFound (Java Evidence.EvidenceNotFoundException) with exactly the message `not_found`. POSIX only. vectors/README.md states the rule.

cases.name: helper_keeps_writing_after_agent_exits_0
cases.script:
printf 'token(spiffe://example.org/wl):
	%s
' 'eyJhbGciOiJFUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImsxIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJhdWQiOlsiaHR0cHM6Ly9hdWQiXSwiZXhwIjo0MTAyNDQ0ODAwLCJzdWIiOiJzcGlmZmU6Ly9leGFtcGxlLm9yZy93bCJ9.AAECAwQFBgcICQoLDA0ODxAREhMUFRYXGBkaGxwdHh8gISIjJCUmJygpKissLS4vMDEyMzQ1Njc4OTo7PD0-Pw'
(i=0; while [ $i -lt 500 ]; do printf 'helper line %s
token(spiffe://example.org/other):
	%s
' "$i" 'eyJhbGciOiJFUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImsxIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.eyJhdWQiOlsiaHR0cHM6Ly9hdWQiXSwiZXhwIjo0MTAyNDQ0ODAwLCJzdWIiOiJzcGlmZmU6Ly9leGFtcGxlLm9yZy9vdGhlciJ9.QEFCQ0RFRkdISUpLTE1OT1BRUlNUVVZXWFlaW1xdXl9gYWJjZGVmZ2hpamtsbW5vcHFyc3R1dnd4eXp7fH1-fw'; sleep 0.01; i=$((i+1)); done) &
exit 0
